content.short: Fiamma is an advanced decentralized protocol designed for seamless blockchain interoperability tools within the Web3 ecosystem on Bitcoin.
content.description: Trustless verification layer for Bitcoin using ZK-proofs. Built organically for the Web3 ecosystem, Fiamma provides an essential suite of services focused heavily on blockchain interoperability tools. By operating on Bitcoin, it allows users to experience fast execution times while maintaining strong cryptographic security. The protocol is designed to be highly interoperable, aiming to become a cornerstone of the Infrastructure Tools sector. Through continuous innovation, Fiamma contributes to the broader vision of a decentralized, permissionless digital economy.
